name: Lifespan
description: Adds a detailed biological lifecycle to Sheltered. Survivors age over time, children undergo physical transitions into adulthood, and elders face the challenges of chronic illness and inevitable natural causes. Features a dynamic genetic potential system for skill growth and realistic hair greying.
missingModWarning: This mod modifies core character data. Saving your game with this mod disabled will permanently reset all survivor ages and wipe their biological history. To protect your generational progress, ensure this mod remains enabled for active playthroughs.
